description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “As Good as it Gets” – a quaint coastal retreat located in the community of Sandy Shores in Seacrest Beach. Enjoy a private seasonally heated saltwater pool, balconies with stunning Gulf views, and a short 150-step stroll to the pristine private beach with seasonal chair service. With easy access to Rosemary and Alys Beaches and 8 beach bikes included— it is as good as it gets! Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS *** Gulf Views from Private Balconies: Start your day with stunning Gulf views or unwind at sunset on the 2nd and 3rd-floor balconies.Private Saltwater Pool: Relax by your own seasonally heated pool with loungers and a dining area for 8—perfect for sunny Florida afternoons.150 Steps to Private Beach Access: Short stroll to a private beach, complete with seasonal chair and umbrella setups.Seasonal Beach Chair Setup: Includes 2 chairs and 1 umbrella, available March 6 - October 31.3 Primary Suites with Balconies: Each suite offers a peaceful retreat with en suite bathrooms and balcony access.Parking for 5 Vehicles: Ample parking for your convenience and all your guests.8 Bikes for Guest Use: Explore the area with beach bikes provided for your stay.Eager to Read More? Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:"Perfect location for relaxing on the private beach just steps away.” – Kristi D."Spacious, clean, and the private pool was an absolute highlight!" – Jeff S."The house name says it all—this was as good as it gets!” – Rick P.*** LIVING AREAS ***Welcome to “As Good as it Gets,” where sophisticated design meets laid-back comfort. The open living area offers plush seating, perfect for relaxing or gathering with loved ones. A smart TV provides endless entertainment, and the wet bar is great for mixing drinks and enjoying casual evenings. Large windows fill the space with natural light, creating a warm, inviting atmosphere you won’t want to leave.Beach-inspired decor with polished finishesSpacious living area with wet bar and smart TVOpen layout perfect for entertaining or relaxing*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The gourmet kitchen features top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances giving you everything needed to prepare meals. Granite countertops offer plenty of prep space, while the oversized island provides extra workspace and doubles as a gathering spot. Whether you're a seasoned chef or enjoy cooking, this kitchen is built to inspire.Fully equipped gourmet kitchen with plenty of prep spaceStainless appliances including a refrigerator, oven, microwave, and dishwasherDining table for 8 and additional island seating for 3Outdoor grill for family cookouts*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Kick off the party on the pool deck! At "As Good as it Gets," you'll soak up the summer sun poolside with everything you need for the perfect outdoor getaway. Your large heated saltwater pool is surrounded by loungers, ideal for relaxing in the sun. Fire up the gas grill and enjoy alfresco dining with seating for eight. Plus, the private beach is just a short walk away!Heated saltwater pool with loungersOutdoor dining area for 8 and grill station8 beach bikes for easy rides to the shore and beyond*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Queen Bedroom: Private access to shared bathroom (tub/shower combo)2nd Floor:Primary Suite 1: King bed, private balcony, en suite with walk-in showerBunk Room: Two Twin-over-Full bunks (Sleeps 6), shared Jack-and-Jill bathroomKing Room: King bed, shared Jack-and-Jill bathroom3rd Floor:Primary Suite 2 (Left): King bed, private balcony, en suite with jetted tub and showerPrimary Suite 3 (Right): King bed, private balcony, en suite with walk-in shower*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest Beach’s exclusive Sandy Shores, this home offers the perfect gateway to experience the best of 30A. Enjoy boutique shopping, gourmet cuisine, and a charming coastal community that’s perfect for biking! Neighboring hotspots like Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach are just a walk or bike ride away, while Peddler's Pavilion provides seasonal live music, dining, and nightlife.Private Community Beach Access just 150 steps awayPeddlers Pavilion: Short stroll awayAlys Beach: 3-minute walkRosemary Beach: 10-minute walkCarillon Beach: 7-minute driveSeacrest Beach Community Overview:Boutique Shopping and Gourmet CuisineQuaint Coastal Community – Bike Friendly!Neighboring Communities – Rosemary Beach and Alys BeachLive Music and Nightlife at Peddler’s Pavilion (Seasonally)*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be added during booking.We DO NOT accept wire transfers.Pool is heated September 1 - April 30A waiver must be signed to use the 8 provided bikes. Additional rentals available through 30A Escapes.Seasonal Beach Chair Setup (2 chairs + umbrella) available March 6 - October 31.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 79384STRO #: STR-079384
